clue.text: Designing fellow responsible for a put-up job

definitions.text: Designing fellow responsible for a put-up job

parts.words: Designing fellow responsible for a put-up job
parts.note: reads like a schemer behind a rigged swindle, but the job literally puts up a building and the fellow draws its design

explanation.surface: A scheming man is behind a rigged fraud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put-up job' means a fix or frame-up; here it is taken literally as a building job, and 'designing' means drawing plans rather than plotting.
explanation.definitionFit: The professional who draws plans for a building that is then put up.

clue.text: A bird that is green

parts.note: a rook is a black crow-family bird
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, meaning that is

explanation.surface: A bird described as being green in colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green' looks like the bird's colour, but it is the definition in its sense of inexperienced.
explanation.definitionFit: Green means inexperienced, and a newcomer or novice is just that.

clue.text: Having silver in the home engenders respect

indicators.note: the word in tells us the silver goes inside the home

parts.note: taken as written
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Owning silver at home makes people look up to you.
explanation.walkthrough: AG goes inside HOME, after its first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Homage is honour or reverence shown publicly, a form of respect.

clue.text: It's the country for Christmas!

parts.note: sounds like a holiday destination recommendation, but the country shares its name with the bird traditionally eaten at Christmas

explanation.surface: A travel tip naming the best nation to spend the festive season in.
explanation.walkthrough: The country in Anatolia shares its name with the festive roast bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation straddling Europe and Asia, and also the traditional Christmas dinner bird.

clue.text: Guilelessness and love may be found in a dog

indicators.note: says the other pieces are located inside the dog word

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
taken as written
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Innocence and affection are qualities a dog possesses.
explanation.walkthrough: AND and O go together inside CUR, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Candour is frankness and openness, the absence of guile.

clue.text: Well people just won't use such transport

definitions.text: Well people just won't use such transport

parts.words: Well people just won't use such transport
parts.note: reads like people simply refusing a vehicle, but 'well' means healthy: only the sick or injured ride in it

explanation.surface: People stubbornly refuse to travel by a certain vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well' looks like a sentence opener ('Well, people just won't...') but means in good health.
explanation.definitionFit: The emergency vehicle that carries sick or injured patients to hospital.

clue.text: Sent if pay-off required for security reasons?

indicators.note: off suggests the letters are out of their proper order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A security guard sent away when pay-off money is demanded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pay-off' looks like a bribe, but 'off' is the anagram signal for SENT IF PAY.
explanation.definitionFit: A clasped pin used to secure clothing or nappies safely, so it serves a fastening purpose.

clue.text: A quarter work out, making great efforts

parts.note: S for south is one of the four quarters of the compass
to work out at the gym is to be in training

explanation.surface: A quarter of people exercise hard and push themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Straining means exerting oneself to the utmost, trying very hard.

clue.text: Give just a single penny in a shopping centre

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, a single unit

indicators.note: the word in places the penny inside the shopping centre

parts.note: a mart is a market or trading place

explanation.surface: Hand over just one penny at the mall.
explanation.walkthrough: P goes inside MART, after its M.
explanation.definitionFit: To impart is to give or bestow, as with knowledge or a quality.

clue.text: Missile destroyed on embargo being arranged

indicators.note: destroyed tells us the following letters are broken up from their original form
being arranged confirms the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A missile is shot down while a trade embargo is negotiated.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved throwing stick, an Aboriginal Australian hunting weapon that returns to the thrower.

clue.text: Bath discovery — the cause of such an outcry!

definitions.text: Bath discovery — the cause of such an outcry!

parts.words: Bath discovery — the cause of such an outcry!
parts.note: suggests a scandal found in the English city of Bath, but refers to Archimedes' shout on noticing displaced water in his tub

explanation.surface: A find in the city of Bath causes a public scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: Bath is an English spa city, but here it is a tub: Archimedes cried out in Greek on discovering his principle while bathing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek exclamation 'I have found it', attributed to Archimedes as he leapt from his tub.

clue.text: The only, one to inform on the French fashion

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing to the police
le is French for the
ton means fashion or style, borrowed from French

explanation.surface: The sole person willing to snitch about French style.
explanation.walkthrough: TON, from the French bon ton, means fashionable style in English.
explanation.definitionFit: A singleton is a single person or thing, the only one of its kind.

clue.text: Prevent the inclusion of any tree

indicators.note: inclusion signals the second piece is placed within the first

parts.note: to ban is to prohibit or prevent
taken as written

explanation.surface: Block the planting of any tree at all.
explanation.walkthrough: ANY goes inside BAN, after its B.
explanation.definitionFit: The banyan is an Indian fig with aerial roots that become extra trunks.

clue.text: A pen-clip -a cunning device

indicators.note: cunning suggests a clever reworking, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pen clip is a clever little gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: An appliance is a machine or gadget built for a particular task.

clue.text: Sound man holding medicos up? That's nice!

parts.note: a toot is a short sound from a horn

indicators.note: holding means the man contains the next piece within him

parts.note: he is a pronoun for a man

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: MOs are medical officers, doctors

explanation.surface: A healthy man is propping up the doctors, which is pleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: MOS reversed by 'up' gives SOM, held inside HE to make HSOME after TOOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Toothsome means tasty or attractive, so it is pleasing or agreeable.

clue.text: Hoards jam

definitions.meaning: to conserve is to save or keep stocks

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means stores up carefully; as a noun it means fruit preserves.

clue.text: Attempt to irritate

definitions.meaning: a go or effort at something

explanation.definitionFit: A noun meaning an effort or go, and a verb meaning to strain or annoy, as in taxing one's patience.

clue.text: Rosie Lee ate freely

indicators.note: freely means the letters are allowed to move about into a new order

explanation.surface: Rosie Lee had a hearty meal without restraint.
explanation.walkthrough: Rosie Lee is Cockney rhyming slang for the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: In Cockney rhyming slang, Rosie Lee stands for the hot drink brewed from leaves.

clue.text: Many a menu includes tropical food

indicators.note: includes shows the answer is contained within the following words

explanation.surface: Many restaurant menus feature exotic dishes from hot countries.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy tuber grown in the tropics and eaten as a staple vegetable.

clue.text: Help for a little thing

parts.note: pro is Latin for for, as in pros and cons
a mote is a tiny speck

explanation.surface: Seeking support for something trivial.
explanation.definitionFit: To promote is to further, encourage or support a cause.

clue.text: Sell the lot

parts.note: sounds like disposing of everything at once, but lot means an item offered at a sale by bidding

explanation.surface: An instruction to dispose of everything.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'lot' is an item put up for bidding.
explanation.definitionFit: A public sale where items, each called a lot, go to the highest bidder.

clue.text: Member of a team prepared to fight

definitions.meaning: a limb, a member of a pair of body parts working together
to equip with weapons ready for battle

explanation.definitionFit: A limb is a body member; as a verb it means to equip with weapons for combat.

clue.text: Blame the salesman taking stroll

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
to rove is to wander or roam

explanation.surface: Criticise the travelling salesman for going on a walk.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprove is to rebuke or censure someone.

clue.text: Most recent trainee given a trial

parts.note: L is the learner, a trainee driver's plate
a test is a trial or examination

explanation.surface: The newest trainee is put through an exam.
explanation.walkthrough: L comes from the L-plate shown by British learner drivers.
explanation.definitionFit: Latest means newest, the most up to date.

clue.text: Leave to explain

definitions.meaning: to ... an argument is to lay it out clearly

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to depart on a journey and to state or present clearly.

clue.text: Dash this stoppage!

definitions.meaning: to dash is to hit or ... violently

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to hit hard; as a noun it means a workers' walkout.

clue.text: Continue to stand

explanation.definitionFit: It means both to last over time and to put up with or tolerate.

clue.text: Put up with fixation that is disturbing

parts.note: a setting is a fixing in place, as of a jewel or concrete

explanation.surface: Tolerating an obsession is distressing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up with' reads as tolerate, but 'Put' is a link and UP stands as written.
explanation.definitionFit: Upsetting means distressing or causing worry.

clue.text: Promise to take the dope by river

parts.note: a dope is a fool, an ass
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Pledge to take the idiot down to the riverside.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ure is a Yorkshire river common in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: To assure someone is to pledge or guarantee something to them.

clue.text: Glaring-and sour too in disposition

indicators.note: disposition, an arrangement of parts, tells us to rearrange the letters

explanation.surface: Staring angrily, with a bitter temperament too.
explanation.definitionFit: Notorious means flagrant or infamous, like a glaring error.

clue.text: Bank on getting a vehicle without decoration

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside places the vehicle around the decoration

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
MBE, Member of the Order of the British Empire, is an honour

explanation.surface: Relying on getting a car with no trim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' looks like 'lacking', but means outside. The MBE is a British honour, a decoration.
explanation.definitionFit: A camber is the banked slope of a road surface.

clue.text: Feared the outcome. So like the winger!

indicators.note: outcome suggests the letters come out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Dreading the result, like a nervous footballer on the wing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' suggests a footballer, but here it is a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Having plumage, as birds do.
